summary: Initial wait calculation overflowed Int32 and stopped before any transaction was submitted.
Slot preparation failed closed before submission; the failed run evidence remains preserved.
AWS transport failed after one Devnet submission acknowledgement, leaving that transaction without worker completion evidence.
Repeated gcloud startup latency missed the next slot; two pending workers were reconciled without automatic retry.
Telegram failed twice in the interrupted run; the final run recorded no transport failure, but operator receipt still requires confirmation.
